text:
:= by
  intro x y
  cases le_total x y with h1 h2
  · have h3 : Int.natAbs x ≤ Int.natAbs y :=
      by rw [Int.natAbs_eq_iff, Int.natAbs_eq_iff] at h1; exact h1
  · have h3 : Int.natAbs x ≤ Int.natAbs y :=
      by rw [Int.natAbs_eq_iff, Int.natAbs_eq_iff] at h2; exact h2
  constructor
  · exact h3
  · exact le_antisymm (Int.natAbs x) (Int.natAbs y) h3 rfl
